system.description:
You Conjure water into the shape of a jellyfish that floats in a space large enough for a small creature. This jellyfish uses the Medical Jellyfish stat block found in the Summon Stat Blocks section.

You may command the Medical Jellyfish as a bonus action on your turn. The Medical Jellyfish may take an appropriate reaction if able, such as attack of opportunity. The Medical Jellyfish uses your Ninjutsu Attack bonus for its attacks and your Save DC for all of its effects save DC’s

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3.
